list.name: Lee：
list.en: I have a toy car. Do you have a toy car, May?
list.cn: 我有一辆玩具车。你有玩具车吗，梅？

list.name: May：
list.en: Yes, I do. My toy car is red and black.
list.cn: 有的，我有。我的玩具车是红色和黑色的。

list.name: Lee：
list.en: Cool!
ball, ball
toy car, toy car
yo-yo, yo-yo
cube, cube

list.name: Hanghang：
list.en: Lee, I have a new cube. I like it very much! Do you have a cube?
list.cn: 李！我有一个新魔方。我非常喜欢它！你有魔方吗？

list.name: Lee：
list.en: No, I don't. But I have a yo-yo. It's yellow and cool.
list.cn: 不，我没有。但我有一个溜溜球。它是黄色的，很酷。

list.name: Hanghang：
list.en: Great! Let's play together!
list.cn: 太棒了！让我们一起玩吧！

list.name: May：
list.en: Zhouzhou, Do you have a doll?

list.name: Zhouzhou：
list.en: Yes, I do. I like it very much!
list.cn: 是的，我有。我非常喜欢它！

list.name: Zhouzhou：
list.en: May, I have a teddy bear.
list.cn: 梅，我有一只泰迪熊玩具。

list.name: May：
list.en: Me, too.

list.name: Hanghang：
list.en: Do you have a cube, Lee?

list.name: Lee：
list.en: No, I don't. But I have a yo-yo.
list.cn: 不，我没有。但我有一个溜溜球。

list.name: Lee：
list.en: Hanghang! Do you have a toy car?

list.name: Hanghang：
list.en: Yes, I do. It's small and yellow.
list.cn: 是的，我有。它是小小的，黄色的。

list.en: Do you have a cube?
Yes, I do.
Do you have a yo-yo?
No, I don't.
I have a toy car. I have a ball.
list.cn: 我有一辆玩具车。我有一个球。

list.en: The car is red. The ball is blue.
list.cn: 车是红色的。球是蓝色的。

list.en: We love toys. We have fun!
list.cn: 我们喜欢玩具。我们玩得很开心！
